title: Agent API Keys
description: Global keys for external LLM / MCP clients. Point them at /mcp or /tools and send Authorization: Bearer <key>.
expandedDescription: These keys are not scoped to a mailbox: any client presenting one over Authorization: Bearer <key> can call the agent tools exposed at /mcp and /tools. Keep them secret — anyone holding a key acts as this account.
empty: No agent API keys yet. Create one to connect an external LLM or MCP client.
createKeyScopeHint: A read-only key is never shown the drafting, sending, moving or deleting tools, and the gateway refuses them even if a client asks for one anyway.
createKeyScopeAllDescription: Read, draft, send, move and delete.
createKeyScopeReadDescription: List mailboxes, read, search and thread mail.
createKeyMailboxesHint: Comma-separated. Leave empty to let the key reach every mailbox.
createdSaveNow: This is the only time the full key is shown. Copy it into your client's configuration now.
createdWarning: You will not be able to see this key again. If you lose it, revoke this key and create a new one.
briefHint: It carries the gateway URL, the key and what to call first — enough to start without guessing.
briefIntro: You are my mail assistant. You read and send my mail through the Mailboxes agent gateway at {{origin}}
briefAuth: Send this header with every request: Authorization: Bearer {{key}}
briefMcp: 1) If your client speaks MCP, connect straight to: {{mcpUrl}}
briefHttp: 2) If you are an agent that can make HTTP calls: GET {{toolsUrl}} for the tool list, then POST {{callUrl}} with a body shaped like {{example}}
briefFirst: Start with list_mailboxes to get a mailboxId — every other tool needs it.
briefScopeAll: This key has full access: read, draft, send, move and delete.
briefScopeRead: This key is read-only: list mailboxes, read, search and view threads.
briefReview: Before sending anything, draft it and ask me to confirm — never send straight away.
revokeConfirmSuffix: ? This takes effect immediately — any external LLM or MCP client still using this key will start receiving 401 responses.
loadFailed: Failed to load agent API keys
createFailed: Failed to create the API key
revokeFailed: Failed to revoke the API key
